# Task: Auto-rebase open PRs when conflicts are detected

## Summary
The daemon should continuously monitor all open PRs it has created and automatically rebase them when merge conflicts are detected.

## Requirements
- Monitor all open PRs created by the daemon
- Detect when a PR has merge conflicts with its target branch
- Automatically trigger a rebase operation when conflicts are detected
- Handle rebase failures gracefully
- Update PR status/comments to reflect rebase activity

## Constraints
- Only rebase PRs that were created by the daemon (not external PRs)
- Respect GitHub API rate limits during monitoring
- Ensure rebase operations don't interfere with ongoing workflow execution
- Must work with the existing daemon task polling architecture

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Daemon detects merge conflicts on open PRs
- [ ] Daemon automatically rebases conflicted PRs
- [ ] Rebase operations are logged appropriately
- [ ] Failed rebases are handled without crashing the daemon
- [ ] PR monitoring integrates with existing daemon task loop
- [ ] Conflicts are resolved or escalated appropriately
